items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for smoother-looking texture and more even-looking tone.
Your scan shows low moisture on dry-looking skin, and a ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.
Retinol calls for daily sunscreen, and this tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides suits deeper skin tones without a chalky look.

response.routine_note: Start by using the retinol 2 nights a week after cleansing, followed by moisturizer, and build up slowly as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the sunscreen every morning, since retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive.
